NATIONAL

FOREWORD

This Indian Standard (First Revision), which is identical with IS0 5721 : 1989 `Tractors for agriculture operator's field of vision', issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopt by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendation of the Agricultural Tractors and Power Tille Sectional Committee and approval of the Food and Agriculture Division Council. This standard was first published in the year 1985 as dual number standard. With the revision of the corresponding IS0 standard in 1989 It was decided to revise this standard in order to align with the corresponding revised IS0 standard. In this revision `Seat Index Point (SIP)' has been used in place of `See Reference Point (SRP)' and the relationship of SIP 90 mm above and 140 mm in front of the SRP hasbeen used. While considering the adoption of the standard, the committee considered and decided to stipulate radius semi-circle in Fig. 2 and 3. Accordingly the following sentence has been added to the~adopted standard a should be read at the end of 6.4.1.5(b): `The radius of the semi-circle in Fig. 2 and Fig. 3 shall be 12 m.' are not identical with those used in thelndian

For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with the final value observed, or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960 `Rules for rounding off numerical values (revised)`. The number of significant places retained the rounded off valueshould be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.
